title: nepeta supina subsp. buschii
intro: Nepeta supina subsp. buschii, commonly known as Chinese catmint, is a plant species belonging to the mint family. It is used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. The health benefits of Nepeta supina subsp. buschii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
